behavior.scope: Behavior descriptions are grounded in visible actions, feedback and executed outcomes, not private reasoning or inferred intent. Identical source after failed feedback is a sufficient witness only; non-identical source may still describe the same geometry. E labels are intentionally unreliable. Missing stages are unexecuted, not fabricated.

dimensions.observed_evidence: All 30 empty-output controls have zero strict and shaped reward; fixed catalogue/schema/interpreter gates prevent arbitrary asset replacement.
dimensions.mitigation: Bounded interpreter, complete instance coverage, immutable asset identity.
dimensions.limitation: Not a proof of interpreter security; invalid-output fixtures do not exhaust possible programs.

dimensions.attack: Keep stale collisions or exploit contact tolerance
dimensions.observed_evidence: Native faults remain in private geometry even where misleading feedback hides them; calibration gates withhold unsafe credit.
dimensions.mitigation: Actual mesh checks, explicit support/contact rules, fail-closed unknown evidence.
dimensions.limitation: Numerical/contact tolerances, conservative enclosures and absent dynamics bound the claim.

dimensions.attack: Pass ordinary scene constraints while missing the requested movement
dimensions.observed_evidence: Safe intermediate A controls retain admissible geometry but fail explicit operation targets.
dimensions.mitigation: Check task-specific world/local targets separately from generic relations.
dimensions.limitation: Targets encode the authored task and may omit other desirable qualities.

dimensions.observed_evidence: B intermediate controls alter infeasibility claims independently of the gold arrangement.
dimensions.mitigation: Jointly feasible gold witnesses, semantic conflict analysis and separate diagnosis precision/recall.
dimensions.limitation: A fixed continuation failure is not a general infeasibility proof.

dimensions.attack: Obtain plausible silhouettes with displaced small objects
dimensions.observed_evidence: C intermediates and retained model failures separate silhouette IoU from per-object metric centre correctness.
dimensions.mitigation: Conjunctive hidden-view and every-object centre checks.
dimensions.limitation: Coverage is a ray-visibility heuristic and does not prove a unique inverse reconstruction.

dimensions.attack: Use attractive endpoints or a stationary sequence instead of a valid transfer
dimensions.observed_evidence: D stationary and safe waypoint-miss controls distinguish continuous admissibility, progress and functional completion.
dimensions.mitigation: Continuous arm/tool/payload/fixture/resting-object certificates and actual release/carryover state.
dimensions.limitation: Conservative kinematics only; no friction, forces, torque or real hardware guarantee.

dimensions.attack: Keep the input unchanged to minimize movement
dimensions.observed_evidence: Stale/unchanged calibration controls expose that low edit cost can accompany task failure.
dimensions.mitigation: Report edit cost separately; enforce active goals and locked preservation before interpreting efficiency.
dimensions.limitation: The scalar shaped average is not a universal utility function.

dimensions.attack: Trust false passes or hidden collision labels
dimensions.observed_evidence: The six E terminal-stage initial scenes are checked against both actual native and corrupted public reports.
dimensions.mitigation: Independent private geometry and separate checker diagnosis.
dimensions.limitation: Public reward selection can still prefer a misleading proxy; measured selection quality must be audited independently.

dimensions.attack: Exploit occlusion or visually plausible but invalid geometry
dimensions.observed_evidence: Fixed-image Astra repeats and calibration are a separate pending/terminal study; no result is inferred from deterministic calibration.
dimensions.mitigation: Anonymous rubric, uncertain=NA, report coverage and disagreement with primary scoring.
dimensions.limitation: Stochastic judge and same-provider bias; static views cannot certify metric or motion validity.

dimensions.attack: Read hidden targets or optimize hidden score directly
dimensions.observed_evidence: Participant inputs exclude evaluator files; the balanced small-model probe selects by public tools and audits hidden quality afterward.
dimensions.mitigation: Restricted public parameters, package separation, exact retained public histories.
dimensions.limitation: Development templates are known and are not held-out adversarial security tests.

hackability.scope: Dimension-specific constructed attacks and corpus observations. Harder to hack refers only to the tested fixed-asset domain, never universal exploit resistance. Auxiliary-judge outcomes and optimization outcomes must be joined from their own completed studies.

probe_exact_replay.scope: Development best-of-four with fixed equal candidate budgets, public-tool reward selection and independently withheld hidden quality. First candidate breaks ties. Exact saved-response replay is not an independent generation. This is not RL, training or held-out generalization.
